name: Monsters of the Sea
source: Growing up in a religious community and early losing his parents made Nino strict towards his little sister Emilia, who nonetheless tries to rebel against her brother. When she sneaks out to go to the beach with her friends and disappears, Nino sets out to look for her.
translation: 尼諾在宗教社區長大，很早便失去雙親，因此對妹妹艾蜜莉亞要求嚴格；然而艾蜜莉亞仍不斷反抗哥哥。某天，她偷偷和朋友去海灘後失蹤，尼諾便出發尋找她。
